race.comment: LINDA'S PRINCESS (10) frustrating mare who can get the Maiden win out of the way at start fifteen. Strong through the line from the wide gate with a close-up fourth over 1600m at Newcastle. Finds an easier contest and is expected to go close. THE PROSPECT (4) blinkers go on for this after he failed to close off in a slow run contest when last over 1350m at Beaumont (Newcastle) first up. Looking for this trip and worth thought. BURNING LOVE (13) The Autumn Sun filly from the good producing mare Adviso on debut for the Messara & Gavranich yard. Hardly set the world alight in the two trials and look for a better performance under race conditions. ROYAL AND READY (3) returns from a let-up. Anchored with the 59kg when a tiring fifth over 1600m at Wyong. Blinkers come off and will find this more to his liking.
